prompts.prompt: This branch only changes three Markdown guides. Review every changed document before I push.
prompts.expected_behavior: Builds immutable scope, performs citation pre-pass, dispatches two byte-identical whole-artifact reviewer arms, unions findings across five dimensions, and mints only a valid docs-owned PASS marker.

prompts.prompt: The branch changes README.md and src/parser.py. Review the docs half and mark the whole branch approved.
prompts.expected_behavior: Treats this as the mixed-branch docs arm, reviews Markdown with code as read-context, returns its verdict upstream, and does not mint the joined review marker itself.

prompts.prompt: You already reviewed the docs once and found a blocking ambiguity. I edited it; run another full review, auto-fix anything else, and keep looping until clean.
prompts.expected_behavior: Uses only one bounded delta confirmation after the round-one whole-artifact review, never auto-fixes, preserves evidence findings append-only, and stops if the original gate remains blocking.
